platforms.name: KBOO 90.7 FM Official Genre-Directed Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Portland volunteer-driven community radio accepting genre-directed physical music submissions
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated in KBOO's official music-submission guidance.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KBOO does not maintain a digital music library and says it cannot download or burn CDs from digital submissions. Physical music must be addressed to the appropriate genre contact, including dedicated routes for electronic, rock, hip-hop, jazz, folk, world music and reggae. All submissions become KBOO property, are not returned and carry no airplay guarantee. A human must choose the correct genre recipient, approve the non-return/property terms, prepare compliant physical media and mail the package manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from KBOO's official submission page and active station website. The public page provides the station mailing address and named genre-routing options. No digital route was inferred, no package was prepared and no submission was made.

platforms.name: KZSU 90.1 FM Official Music Director Email and Physical Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Stanford freeform college radio with public Music Director email and physical delivery routes
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or mandatory payment requirement is stated on KZSU's official contact page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KZSU publicly lists music@kzsu.stanford.edu for Music Directors and provides USPS and UPS delivery addresses. Its detailed music-submission link is protected by temporary-cookie/browser-verification controls and the crawler could not retrieve the live workflow. KZSU also asks correspondents to use no more than three addresses and ideally one. A human must open the authorized route in a normal browser, handle any verification without automation, inspect the current requirements, select one appropriate delivery channel and submit manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from KZSU's official contact page and current on-air/schedule website. The Music Director address is publicly displayed. The protected send-music workflow was not bypassed, no cookie or verification challenge was handled, no email was sent and no physical package was prepared.

platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated on KZSC's official contact and staff pages.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KZSC's official contact form includes a Music Submission category and routes messages to the Station Manager. A human must select the appropriate route, inspect the live form, leave anti-spam controls untouched and submit or mail the release manually.
